notes: Calibrated from the initial 32-scenario corpus run on the snapshot-fixed replay engine (feat/eval-corpus-gates, Sep 2026). Correctness gates are zero-tolerance product promises from the build spec: no false alerts on normal air, no silent misses on follower patterns, byte-identical determinism, restart equivalence, inert display rendering. worst_latency_cycles=2 is the observed corpus-wide slowest first detection (evil twins at the twin's cycle, co-travel at the second stop). It is set to the exact observed value on purpose: replay is deterministic, so any move of this number is a behavior change that must be reviewed and re-calibrated, never auto-waived. Sep 2026 evidence-first recalibration (B1/B2 bundle): status now derives from incident lifecycle rows, so single-detector scenarios hold at WATCH (one detector can never alert under the fusion gate) and the seven former alert labels read watch; deauth-quiet-tail-restart-stable reads clear because its long quiet tail stale-closes the incident per the lifecycle's stale-close rule. The alert band is expected to be re-reached (and labels re-raised) by the follow-up fusion/taxonomy bundle. Labels count incident subjects, not store rows: detector rows are contributions to their phenomenon.
